svg.title: The silent version failure is the dangerous one
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The silent version failure is the dangerous one” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. One fitted pipeline object drawn as nested boxes crosses a dashed version wall from scikit-learn 1.9.0 to 1.5.2 by three arrows: logistic regression ends in a loud AttributeError, random forest loads with a zero prediction difference, and HistGradientBoosting loads silently wrong with a prediction difference of 1.525e-01 circled in red; below, a latency bar splits 5.127 milliseconds into preprocessing and model time against a batched 0.0103 milliseconds per row, and a PSI ruler places three drift measurements against the 0.10 and 0.25 thresholds.
svg.text: The silent version failure is the dangerous one
draw it from memory, then compare
